critical_unknowns: deficit thresholds and telemetry schema remain host-designed
procedure cards and retrieval tags are hand-authored
trusted primitive executor set is fixed by the host
acquire_behavioral_knowledge does not yet synthesize and validate a new procedure from raw evidence
capability boundaries are not autonomously learned
frozen benchmark is synthetic and authored within the same research program
procedure language is bounded and does not yet support arbitrary safe branching/looping plans
no real multi-agent/tool-connector failure integration in the frozen benchmark
no real filesystem/VCS transactional rollback integration
runtime assumes objective telemetry is available and sufficiently trustworthy
robustness under noisy or contradictory telemetry is not established
catalog breadth does not imply all 312 suboperators are executable
next_high_value_frontier: autonomous behavioral procedure acquisition/induction from raw docs, failure traces and examples with sandbox verification, challenger tests, promotion, quarantine and rollback
